svg.title: Binit accepts and cancels sooner than ble.sh; plain Readline is ahead on a big menu and in-shell accepts
svg.desc: Binit accepts and cancels sooner than ble.sh; plain Readline is ahead on a big menu and in-shell accepts. Medians. Own-process accept and cancel are scored against ble.sh; the in-shell accept and plain Readline are reported. Accepting, own process: Binit 0.29 ms, ble.sh 35.7 ms, Plain Readline 0.48 ms. Accepting, inside the shell: Binit 0.35 ms, ble.sh 27.4 ms, Plain Readline 0.28 ms. Cancelling a 1,024-item menu: Binit 13.7 ms, ble.sh 57.8 ms, Plain Readline 2.5 ms. Binit 0.1.0 on one Linux machine: Ryzen 7 7800X3D, GNU Bash 5.3.20.
